description:
## Problem
Two code quality issues in `Fetcher`:

1. **Dead code**: `handle_fetch_result` (lines 213-226) is never called — `fetch_loop` uses only `handle_fetch_result_with_uri`.

2. **DRY violation**: `handle_gray_placeholder` and `handle_gray_placeholder_with_uri` (lines 228-253) are near-duplicates differing only in return type (tuple with/without URI).

## File
- `src/vug/fetcher.cr`

## Fix
1. Remove `handle_fetch_result` entirely.
2. Remove `handle_gray_placeholder` and keep only `handle_gray_placeholder_with_uri`. Update any callers.

## Acceptance
- No references to removed methods
- All existing tests pass
- No behavioral change
title: Remove dead code and deduplicate Fetcher methods
